s1.note: Referrer registers on honorcu.com/refer-a-friend/ to get a custom referral link and shares it with friends and family via Facebook, Facebook Messenger, or email.

s2.note: The referred friend must: open a new savings and checking account; complete 8 debit card transactions; have an incoming ACH or direct deposit of $500 or more; have a valid email address; complete requirements within 60 days of account opening.

s3.note: A member can receive up to $500 for referrals in a calendar year.

s4.note: Reward is a $25 Mastercard Prepaid Card delivered by email; must have a valid email address. Page crawled 2026-09-23 and currently live.

s5.note: Estimated 5-15 minutes of active time to register and share the referral link.

s6.note: Offer ongoing on the official page (checked 2026-09-23); no end date stated.

s7.note: No tax disclosure stated on the referral page.
